summary: Verified the two new fixes: (1) POST /admin/trust-cases/{id}/admin-documents/from-trust-draft imports the trust_draft PDF into admin_documents[] with a fully populated ai_explanation, marks source='trust_draft', is idempotent, and returns 400/404/401 correctly; (2) DELETE /admin/trust-cases/{id}/trust-draft removes the PDF, clears trust_sections + trust_sections_draft, sets trust_draft_deleted_at/by, marks previously-imported explainer docs source_orphaned=true so their AI explanations are preserved. Backend pytest: 14/14 pass. Frontend Playwright end-to-end (fresh case → upload draft → import → duplicate-click idempotent → delete draft → verify reset + card persists) all steps PASS. Screenshot confirms the imported card renders with WHAT IT IS / WHAT IT DOES / WHY IT MATTERS / NOTARIZATION / WHAT YOU SHOULD DO — user's core blocker ('AI Document Explainer isn't generating') is fixed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2760: ALLOWED_EXPLAINER_EXTS constant is defined immediately after the `return` of admin_delete_trust_draft with NO blank line between them (looks like `return {..}\nALLOWED_EXPLAINER_EXTS = {...}`). Purely cosmetic — add two blank lines for PEP-8 compliance and readability.

server.py is now 4,948 lines. Splitting into per-domain routers (trust_draft_router, admin_docs_router, whatsapp_router, auth_router) would materially improve maintainability. Repeat of prior iteration note.

admin_delete_trust_draft best-effort storage delete swallows all exceptions with only a warning log. If the object-store 'delete' fails, the case is still cleared and the user sees success — orphaned bytes will accumulate. Consider surfacing a soft warning to the admin UI or a background reconciliation job.

from-trust-draft idempotency key is (source='trust_draft' AND source_storage_path==draft.storage_path AND not is_deleted). If admin deletes the imported card (sets is_deleted=true) and then clicks Import again, a NEW entry will be created — probably desirable but worth documenting.
from-trust-draft returns 502 on storage read failure with the raw exception string in `detail`. Consider redacting internal storage paths from user-facing errors.

seed_data_creation: Created ~10 ephemeral client accounts (prefixed tdtest_/tdcase_/e2etd_/e2etd2_) each owning one trust case (prefixed TEST_TD_ / E2E_TD_ / E2E2_). Cases have a single uploaded trust_draft PDF (~1.5 KB) plus one imported 'Trust Draft — …' admin_documents entry with AI explanation. Two of these ended with source_orphaned=true after the delete flow — safe to leave, they demonstrate the intended state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes are fully functional across backend + frontend. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_trust_draft_explainer.py can be re-used as regression. For future runs, note that /admin/trust-cases/{id}/admin-documents (regular upload) requires multipart body with fields 'label' (Form) + 'file' (UploadFile). The from-trust-draft endpoint takes NO body — just POST to it. Idempotency lookup matches on source_storage_path so replacing the draft (which creates a new storage object at a different path) will legitimately allow a re-import; deleting the imported card and re-clicking Import will also create a new card (idempotency is is_deleted-aware).
